svg.text: namespaces: server · venv · config · backends · session · plugins · popup
server.fetch() bypasses renderer (trusts self-signed localhost cert)
adds X-SF-Desktop-Secret header to authorize main → server calls
bundles server + aigateway src, prebuilt Python + uv, wheel cache
targets: macOS dmg/zip · Linux AppImage · Windows NSIS
Foundation plugins (shared ABCs / infra — no business routes)
• backend-api-base — Run wire format · aigw-base — gateway client (mode/url)
fan-out + reduce · broadcast · collection iteration · X-SF-Run-Id header
Backend plugins — model adapters (one Claude/Codex/Gemini backend active at a time)
Frontend proxies + Interceptors — capture coding-CLI traffic
can run an active URL4 spec inline
plugins depend on core ports (never reverse)
• Renderer hooks never touch the network directly
• All I/O crosses the preload electronAPI bridge
• Main owns server lifecycle, venv, sessions, config
• server.fetch() in main bypasses renderer SSL pinning
• 5 registries: Plugin, Hook, Class, Route, Frontend
• Core defines interfaces; plugins are the adapters
• Plugins import core, never the reverse (DI)
• Each model has a frontend proxy and a backend adapter
• Backend = direct API OR via AIGateway (exclusive)
• Interceptors steer CLIs to the right frontend port
• url4-executor parses a URL4 expression on /ensemble
• Fan-out: run N backends in parallel
• Reduce: feed all responses to a reducer model
• eval-runs records accuracy; RunView polls it
